title: Claude Sonnet 5 Is Now the Default in Claude
description:
Claude Sonnet 5 just became the default model in Claude.
Opus used to be the one people paid up for when they wanted it done right. Now the default is almost as good.
Coding benchmark: 63 (Sonnet 5) vs 69 (Opus). Close. And on knowledge work, Sonnet 5 actually edges ahead.
Bigger models like Mythos and Fable still have a wider gap, but those look like they're moving out of the standard subscription, so they'll only be there if you pay extra.
Which Claude model are you actually using? Comment below.
